notToBeConfusedWith.name: Chocolate liqueur
notToBeConfusedWith.note: A broader modern category, often cream-based; creme de cacao is the older cocoa-and-sugar infusion with no dairy in it.

forms.label: Brown
forms.sourceNote: Marie Brizard's brown cocoa liqueur is taken as the reference bottle; its own product page states 20% ABV. No sugar or nutrition panel is published, so sugarGPer100 and nutritionPer100g are left off rather than estimated. No measured density is published either; the site's own liqueur-sweet class (1.09 g/ml, a sugar-dominant liqueur near 25% ABV) is used as the nearest estimate, since a cocoa-and-sugar cordial at this proof sits closer to that class than to a plain 40%-ABV spirit.

forms.label: White
forms.sourceNote: The clear, uncoloured style of the same liqueur; cocoa solids are filtered out after infusion rather than left in, which is a colour and clarity difference only. Figures follow the brown Form: Marie Brizard states the same 20% ABV across both colours, and neither carries a published sugar or nutrition panel.
